description.name: SSLCommerz Payment Gateway
description.tagline: Bangladesh's first online payment gateway integration for WHMCS with full v4 API support.
description.long: SSLCommerz Payment Gateway module for WHMCS. Implements v4 session creation, order validation, IPN, refunds, idempotent settlement, capture-time currency conversion, and transaction reconciliation. Supports EasyCheckout popup, hosted redirect, and the production new hosted checkout experience.
features: Checkout with SSLCommerz for a faster checkout & payment experience
EasyCheckout Popup and hosted checkout modes
Transaction ledger with an audit trail
